prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE complete visual direction concept for an ancient Chinese cultivation game's LOW-LEVEL FORMATION DISC, fully assembled with exactly FOUR small modular formation-material components. Entirely NEW design, not an edit or recolor of any old image.
Direction A: CINNABAR AND CARVED WOOD — a working tool hand-made by a modest wandering array cultivator. The object should convey the intimate craft of spiritual wood, engraved array-patterns and carefully brushed spirit ink. This specific ebony combination is an original game design, not an illustration of any novel's canonical object.
Strict orthographic 90-degree TOP-DOWN view. Show the complete handheld thin dark ebony / worn thunder-patterned spiritual-wood plate: a short SQUARE with substantially clipped corners, giving an eight-sided squared silhouette, emphatically NOT a circle. Low-profile edges, beautiful restrained natural black-brown wood grain, a little honest hand-tool wear, a few small knife-cut talismanic marks. Sparse dark copper staples and wood tenons fix the parts; no big metal rim. Plain, practical and crafted with intent, not a luxurious antique serving tray or jewelry display.
Exactly FOUR DISTINCT assembled components, with generous breathing room between them:
1. Small SQUARE carved pale-jade seal block as the coordinating core, near the middle-left, one quiet abstract incised seal mark on its top, no readable words; not a wheel or jewel brooch.
2. One low horizontal 2:1 SPIRIT-STONE TROUGH near the lower-left, a worn wood-and-thin-copper channel holding one continuous rough ivory-grey spirit-stone insert; not two repeated gems and not an electronic battery.
3. One compact 1:1 BONE-JADE NEEDLE SEAT near the upper-left: a fine pale carved bone/jade sensing needle anchored in one small dark wood cradle; a functional carved sensing piece, not a compass dial or modern chip.
4. One slim vertical 1:2 EXECUTION ASSEMBLY at the right: TWO flat incised jade/wood talisman tablets layered lengthwise within ONE narrow wooden clamp, distinct overlapping edges. It is a joined tablet mechanism, NOT a shield, not a heraldic shield outline, not a pendant and not a flag.
Connect them in two visually distinct clean noncrossing routes while leaving the core seal largely free: a narrow CINNABAR signal route, hand-brushed and lightly engraved into the wood, runs from sensing seat through the upper open space toward the upper end of the vertical execution assembly; a separate extremely fine GOLD-GREY SPIRIT-SAND inlay route runs from the lower-left energy trough along the lower open space toward the lower end of the same assembly. The cinnabar must look like an array-master's deliberate ink strokes on wood, with beautiful pressure variation and small carved accents, NOT red plastic cable. The supply vein must look like tiny mineral grains embedded in a shallow groove, NOT green plumbing, thick metal pipe or a gemstone chain. NO crossing between these two routes. Curves and turns can be hand-worked, no modern circuit-board graphics. Neither route passes through any unrelated component.
High-quality Chinese ink-and-light-watercolor game-prop illustration, detailed tactile craftsmanship but broad readable forms at small size; smoky dark wood, bone ivory, pale restrained jade, muted cinnabar, tiny dull mineral and copper accents. Quiet and simple rather than ornate. All four principal parts must have DIFFERENT clear silhouettes. Square canvas, whole plate centered with about 7% clean alpha-transparent margin on all sides. Crisp silhouette, actual transparent background outside the object; no floor, tabletop, landscape, hands, person, brush, loose spare materials, banner or cast shadow outside the object.
Absolute exclusions: visible grid or checker squares, game-piece sockets, chessboard or go board, UI, captions, labels, numbers, text paragraphs, arrows, modern PCB, plastic electronics, chip pins, logos, giant yin-yang symbol, big circular magic mandala, multiple crossed wires, shield-shaped parts, extravagant gold frame, a circle tray, gemstones in gilded medallions, neon, glow, mist or atmosphere. ONE complete assembled modest wooden formation instrument, no multiple variants and no extra objects.
